subject: Sensing: strap on demo day, and demo gate defaults
body: 1) Will a standard BLE heart-rate strap (Polar H10 or similar) be available on demo day, and on which device and browser? Web Bluetooth needs Chrome on desktop or Android; it does not work on iOS. 2) For a 3-minute demo I plan a 60 s refractory (the research design says 10 min) and a script with one cue fire and one sham. OK?
